conceptZh: 積木小隊先蓋出一個歪歪的屋頂，發現不對，聳聳肩一翻就變成「今」。
object: a squad of interlocking building bricks
morph: bricks proudly assemble a wrong flat roof, notice, and flip one piece to complete 今
creativeAngle: 先錯後對，今天的太陽用積木升起來。
promptEn: An 8-second animated clip on a pale sunshine yellow background, with one single Traditional Chinese glyph 今 as the only text on screen, drawn in bright cobalt blue solid strokes, centered, uncropped, about 70% of frame height with generous margins. 0-1.7s: a squad of red, blue and green bricks with tiny painted faces marches in a line and stacks itself into a lopsided triangle roof; the first 今 is spoken as the roof bricks click on top. 1.7-3.4s: proudly they add a flat bar beneath, but it is the wrong way, a box that looks like a hat; the bricks freeze, glance at each other, and shrug; the second 今 is spoken as one brick pops out and the bar slides into the right 人-plus-short-stroke shape under the roof. 3.4-5s: 今天 is spoken as a tiny yellow brick sun rises over the glyph on a spring, with the little bricks cheering and bouncing. 5-8s: hold; the glyph stays still while one brick does a small spin and a happy wobble well clear of the strokes. Audio: a warm off-screen voice in clear Taiwanese Mandarin reads exactly "今、今、今天" (ㄐㄧㄣ、ㄐㄧㄣ、ㄐㄧㄣ ㄊㄧㄢ), slowly and distinctly with clear tones, a short pause between the two single utterances, and stops after the word; no other speech, no subtitles, no vocabulary text. Final 3 seconds (5-8s): the glyph 今 is perfectly still and fully readable while the lead keeps a small joyful motion away from the strokes. Bright but not neon palette, no watermark, no flashing, no other writing.

conceptZh: 玩具戰士想把小太陽舉到最高，踩著腳尖把花生搬來的泡棉長條一根根疊成搖搖晃晃的高塔，花生敬錯禮時一顆小橡果滾到塔頂，整座塔嘩啦倒下，長條剛好疊成「今」，戰士被埋住只剩眼睛，小太陽在字上方跳出來。
object: a chunky toy warrior with a foam sword and round shield, a wobbling stack of foam beams carried by Peanut the cartoon raccoon, one tiny acorn, and a smiling toy sun on a spring
morph: the swaying tower of foam beams topples; two long beams lean together into the peaked roof of 今, a short beam lands flat beneath as the horizontal bar, and the floppy foam sword bends into the hooked stroke at the bottom, all snapping into clean solid strokes
creativeAngle: 改用疊高再倒塌的實體笨拙喜劇：戰士愛逞強、踩腳尖疊塔，花生在最糟時機敬禮讓橡果滾上塔頂，一拍停頓後嘩啦倒下，倒下的長條就是「今」的三個部件（人字屋頂、一橫、下方勾），而「今天」由跳出的小太陽具象化。與前版積木小隊慢慢排字完全不同，動作每兩秒換一拍。
promptEn:
An 8-second animated clip on a pale cream background with only one piece of text on screen: the Traditional Chinese glyph 今 in bold solid cobalt-blue strokes, centered, uncropped, about 70% of frame height with generous margins. Lead: a chunky plastic toy warrior with a floppy foam sword, a round shield, a huge grin and zero skill. Supporting: Peanut, a cartoon raccoon sidekick, carrying a wobbling stack of foam beams far too tall for him.

0-1.5s: the warrior struts in from the left, plants his shield and points dramatically at a small smiling toy sun sitting on the floor, then thrusts both arms up: he wants it hoisted higher than anything. Peanut totters in behind him, beams swaying. The first 今 is spoken as the warrior snatches the bottom beam and slams it upright to start a tower.

1.5-3.5s: fast comic stacking: beam, beam, shield, beam, the warrior up on tiptoe, tongue out, the tower leaning wider with every piece while Peanut hands up pieces. He balances the toy sun on the very top. Peanut snaps a proud salute at exactly the wrong moment and his one little acorn rolls off his head onto the tower top.

3.5-4.5s: freeze. Everything hangs still for a beat, the acorn teetering, the warrior's eyes going wide. Then the whole tower comes down in a tumbling, squashy heap with a soft cartoon thump, puffing up a little dust cloud.

4.5-5s: the dust clears. Two long beams have landed leaning against each other as the peaked roof, a short beam lies flat beneath it, and the bent foam sword curls into the short hooked stroke below. They snap into clean solid cobalt strokes forming a perfect 今. The second 今 is spoken on that snap. Only the warrior's two blinking eyes poke out of the pile well below the glyph.

5-8s: the glyph 今 holds perfectly still and fully readable for the final 3 seconds. The spoken word 今天 lands as the toy sun boings up on a spring above the glyph, beaming and bobbing. The warrior pops his head free, dizzy, does a slow woozy spin and a proud double thumbs-up in the bottom corner, never touching the strokes, while Peanut salutes again, this time correctly.

Audio: a warm, friendly off-screen voice in clear Taiwanese Mandarin reads exactly 今、今、今天 (ㄐㄧㄣ、ㄐㄧㄣ、ㄐㄧㄣ ㄊㄧㄢ), slowly and distinctly with clear tones, a short pause between the two single utterances, and stops after the word. No other speech, no subtitles, no vocabulary text, soft background music quieter than the voice. Bright but not neon palette, no watermark, no flashing, no other writing.
